| Commit | What | Code matched |
|---|---|---|
| `feat(overlays)` 6f95fce | 619 level-code matches from our own waves; one box per level | 8.72% → 13.54% |

| `feat(port)` 64f52e4 | 105 functions ported from Lombyte | 13.54% → 15.25% |
| `feat(waves)` a0e8021 | salvage, near-miss waves, long-function trials | — |
| `feat(overlays)` 758822c | 24 more level-code matches | 15.25% → 15.48% |
| `feat(port)` 859e60d | 7 more functions ported from Lombyte | 15.48% → 15.60% |

## Our matches (643 functions)

opened.title: Level 18 (Veldin 2): decompile the level's code
opened.author: Lynder063
opened.untrustedBody:
Working PR for level 18 (Veldin 2, `src/overlays/l18_veldin2/`). Everything we get goes in here, matched or not; still a draft.

## Status

Level 18: **79 of 122 functions exact, 29,360 of 154,848 bytes** (19.0% of the level's code, **26.5%** counting the staged near misses). 42 were already matched before this branch. Two more are matched but invisible to the report, which does not see a definition whose name is an `__asm__` alias (`func_L18_002D6B58`, `func_L18_002F1AB0`); those drop out of the totals instead of counting, which is why the function count fell from 123.

Plus `func_L05_003053D8` (level 5), which the tooling fix below unblocked.

Every function is checked with `tools/try_func.py` (every byte and relocation at its real level address), re-checked in the final file with `tools/overlay_file_check.py`, and `progress/report.json` is regenerated in the same commit.

merged.title: docs/include: add community reverse engineering reference and engine headers
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
### Summary

This PR contributes reverse-engineering reference documentation, foundational engine headers, and a dedicated **decomp.dev** progress reporting GitHub Actions workflow for *Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando* (RaC2), synthesized from the `#rac-ps2-reverse-engineering` community research archive (2018–2026), Aug 8 2002 prototype datamining, and cross-game engine analysis.

---

### What is included

1. **`docs/COMMUNITY-ENGINE-REFERENCE.md`**:
   - Synthesizes findings on executable editions, SDK 2.5.5, and toolchain configurations.
   - Documents the dynamic level overlay layout (`.lit`, `.bss`, `.data`, `lvl.vtbl`, `lvl.camvtbl`, `lvl.sndvtbl`, `.text`).
   - Details the Insomniac Moby actor model (first `0x28` bytes matching Deadlocked `MobyInstance`, `modeBits` flags, function pointer offsets at `0x64 pUpdate`, `0x68 pVar`, `0x6C oClass`, `0x6E UID`).
   - Documents the weapon upgrade table bitmask layout (Lock-on `0x01`, Shock `0x02`, Acid `0x04`).
   - Documents event fl
